title: How refunds work
content: Refunds for duplicate or incorrect charges are issued within 5-7 business days to the original payment method.

title: Downloading invoices
content: Invoices are available under Settings > Billing > Invoices and can be exported as PDF.

title: Fixing API 401/403 errors
content: Regenerate your API key under Settings > Developer and send it in the Authorization header.

title: App crashes on startup
content: Clear the app cache and update to the latest version. If it still crashes, send us the crash log.

title: Export jobs timing out
content: Exports over 1M rows run asynchronously; you will receive an email with a download link.

title: Resetting your password
content: Use Forgot password on the login page. Reset links expire after 30 minutes.

title: Setting up two-factor authentication
content: Enable 2FA under Settings > Security. Backup codes can be regenerated there too.
